---
title: "Concepts"
---

Fair Data Finder helps Deltares staff find and register research datasets.
This page introduces the main ideas used throughout the application. Later
pages explain how these ideas appear in the [data model](data-model.qmd),
[metadata](metadata-schema.qmd), and [STAC](stac.qmd).

## Mental model

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  D[Domain<br/>STAC Collection]
  F[Keyword facility]
  KG[Keyword groups]
  K[Keywords]
  I[Dataset<br/>STAC Item]
  A[Assets<br/>data access links]
  P[projectNumber<br/>optional]

  D -->|contains| I
  D -->|links to| F
  F --> KG --> K
  K -.->|copied onto| I
  I --> A
  P -.-> I
```

## Dataset / record

A **dataset** (also called a registered item or record) is one published
research data product. In Fair Data Finder it is stored and exposed as a
[STAC Item](stac.qmd#stac-in-fair-data-finder): a GeoJSON Feature with
metadata properties, optional geometry, and one or more assets.

In the UI this is what you create under [Register](register.qmd) and find
under [Search](search.qmd).

## Projects and datasets

There is **no separate Project entity** in the database. A dataset may
optionally carry a project number in metadata (`properties.projectNumber`).
The registration form labels the dataset title as *Project title*, but that
value is stored as the Item's `properties.title`.

In short: a project number is an optional attribute of a dataset, not a
parent object that owns datasets.

## Metadata

Metadata is the descriptive information attached to a dataset (title,
description, dates, originators, legal restrictions, keywords, and so on).
It is stored on the STAC Item's `properties` object and returned by the API.
See [Metadata schema](metadata-schema.qmd).

## Domains

A **domain** is a topical category for datasets (for example Ecology). In
the application, Domains are implemented as [STAC Collections](stac.qmd).
Every dataset belongs to exactly one domain (its `collection`).

Domains are managed in the [Domains](domains.qmd) tab by Data Stewards.

## Keywords

Keywords are a controlled vocabulary used to tag datasets. They live in the
application database as a three-level hierarchy:

**Facility → Keyword group → Keyword**

A domain (Collection) can be linked to a keyword facility. When you register
a dataset, selected keywords are **copied onto** the Item as
`properties.keywords`. Filtering in Search uses those keyword ids.

Managed in the [Keywords](keywords.qmd) tab.

## Data access

How to reach the actual data files or services is recorded as **STAC Assets**
on the Item: each asset has at least a title, type, and `href` (URL or path).
Legal context is recorded separately in fields such as `legalRestrictions`
and `restrictionsOfUse`.

## Spatial and temporal information

| Aspect | How it is represented |
|--------|------------------------|
| Spatial footprint | Item `geometry` and `bbox` (GeoJSON). May be `null` for global / non-spatial datasets |
| Coordinate reference | `properties.spatialReferenceSystem` |
| Instant in time | `properties.datetime` |
| Time range | `properties.start_datetime` and `properties.end_datetime` |
| Publication date | `properties.publication_datetime` |

Datasets without geometry appear in Search as *Global Dataset* and are not
drawn on the map.

## How this maps to STAC

| Fair Data Finder concept | STAC / storage |
|--------------------------|----------------|
| Domain | Collection (pgSTAC) |
| Dataset / record | Item (pgSTAC) |
| Data access link | Asset on the Item |
| Keyword vocabulary | Application tables (`facility`, `keyword_group`, `keyword`) |
| Keywords on a dataset | Item `properties.keywords` |
| Project number | Item `properties.projectNumber` only |

The next sections spell out the [data model](data-model.qmd) and the
[STAC API](stac.qmd).
